name: Proud Tek RF / Production Engineering
jobTitle: RF / production engineering function — chip and antenna matching, encoding specification, QC sign-off
shortBio: Technical reviewer byline: the engineering function that matches chip families and antenna designs to installed readers, writes the encoding specification and signs off production batches with Quality Control.
bio: Proud Tek RF / Production Engineering is the reviewer byline on product specification pages, compatibility guides and technical articles. The function owns the product and antenna specification, matches chip families and antenna designs to the buyer's installed readers or locks before production starts, writes the encoding specification that partner lines execute, approves the first article and — together with Quality Control — signs off every batch before release. Specification claims on reviewed pages are checked against the vendor datasheet cited in each page's sources block. In line with our sister brand RFIDAK, the byline names the function, not an individual.
expertise: Encoding specification (UID, NDEF, GS1 EPC, key diversification)
First-article approval and batch QC sign-off
